731950101.text: This Bulletin Board is set up by Vizier to publicize important matters in Sumeru City. Questions or doubts regarding the notices on the Bulletin Board can be posted here as well.

731950201.text: "Notice: We are looking for experts to deal with Rishboland Tigers"

731950202.text: The message of the notice is blotted with a paintbrush. Beside it is a sentence in slanting, childish handwriting...

731950203.text: "Rishboland Raja just wanted to play with people!"

731950301.text: "If you see dancing fairies after consuming mushrooms, please do not be alarmed. It is a normal reaction."

731950302.text: "But if the plants around you are starting to speak, please seek help from the nearest Forest Ranger immediately."

731950401.text: "Due to unknown reasons, The Withering has been showing signs of expansion in both quantity and size throughout the forest."

731950402.text: "Not only does The Withering cause vegetation in the area to wilt, it may also be lethal to wildlife and even humans. The Forest Watchers have set up Contamination Zones to mark the area under the influence of The Withering. Please stay away from such areas."

731950403.text: "If you notice a new patch of The Withering in the forest, please contact a nearby Forest Ranger to have it handled professionally."

731950501.text: The matra have discovered multiple cases of illegal Canned Knowledge trade during recent inspections in local bazaars.

731950502.text: Trading of Canned Knowledge is prohibited by the Akademiya and will be severely punished upon discovery.

731950503.text: The Akademiya will not be held responsible for any consequences of illegal usage of Canned Knowledge.

731950601.text: "The annual Sabzeruz Festival is just around the corner. A grand festival will be held in the Grand Bazaar same as last year."

731950602.text: "To heat up the festive ambiance, our lady has prepared a special subsidy for all participating merchants."

731950603.text: "Let's celebrate Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday together!"

731950701.text: "Our lady left home and still hasn't returned. If you see a young girl with brown hair wearing a blue and purple dress, please contact the Homayani family. You will be duly thanked for your help!"

731950702.text: "If our lady herself sees this poster, please contact us immediately. Your parents are very worried about you."

731950801.text: "He's back! My Lord, Al-Ahmar, is back!"

731950802.text: "The day he returns will be the day of retribution for all you leaf-heads!"

731950803.text: This is fake news, and we are currently investigating its source. All matters in Sumeru are posted regularly in the Akasha. Please do not trust any rumors.

731950901.text: "My friend, are you troubled by anything? Look no further! The Almighty Lord Sangemah Bay is here to give you all the answers you seek."

731950902.text: "All it costs is a little Mora, and all your problems will be resolved in no time."

731950903.text: "Take action before it's too late! Contact information..."

731950904.text: This Bulletin Board is set up by Sir Vizier to regulate market transactions. Please do not post any advertisements here.

731951001.text: "Does anyone know where to find an excellent storyteller? It has to be someone who can tell a story exactly as it is."

731951002.text: "I'm being haunted by a terrifying Jinni. It's threatening to kill me if I don't tell it the exact same story every day. It's been a month now, and my brain is turning to mush from this torture..."

731951003.text: "What a strange experience. But I've heard of a storyteller called Maddah in Puspa Café. He might be able to help you."

731951101.text: "I've been to many nations and watched countless performances. There isn't a shred of doubt in me that Nilou is the best dancer in Teyvat. But not only were the pedants from the Akademiya unable to appreciate her performance, they even complained about it! What an insult to art!"

731951102.text: "Based on my experience in Mondstadt, we should organize a fan club for Nilou. Then those people who don't know anything about art wouldn't dare to insult her again."

731951103.text: "A fan club... Is that a part of Mondstadt's culture? Anyway... A perfect performance is a joint effort of everyone in the troupe. Placing all the attention on a single person is just not fair."

731951104.text: "Moreover, I believe that art itself is a bond that brings people together. I'm very happy that you enjoyed Nilou's performance."

731951105.text: "Based on that elegant handwriting, you must be a young lady, right? It's so good to know that there's someone else who enjoys watching dance performances. May I ask if you would like to have a cup of coffee together sometime?"

731951106.text: "Sorry, I'm very busy. Please speak to my manager if you need any help."

731951107.text: "Looks like this guy got rejected. The final message is clearly written by a tough man... he's probably the bodyguard of a rich lady or something."

731951201.text: "Magic bottles for sale. Magic bottles that can harness the power of spirits. Please leave your payment here. Grants any wish, only one Mora."

731951202.text: "Magic bottles for sale. Magic bottles that grant any wishes. The price is only one Mora."

731951203.text: "I'm a Jinni. Just give me one Mora and I'll grant any wish of yours."

731951204.text: "The Citadel of Regzar is investigating the recent string of scams. Please do not panic."

731951205.text: "Any victims who have further questions may seek consultation for just one Mora."

731951301.text: "Ever since I became a Forest Watcher, I spent all my time in the forest. If this keeps up, I'm gonna start talking to Dusk Birds."

731951302.text: "If only I could understand them... I wouldn't be as bored as I am now."

731951401.text: "I hired a pretty decent mercenary a while ago. I think she's called Flame-Mane or something..."

731951402.text: "I brought her along with me each time I went out to the sea for business. Doesn't matter if it's Treasure Hoarders or the Millelith — with her by my side, there was nothing to fear. I made a fortune all thanks to her."

731951403.text: "But I don't think I've seen her accepting any commissions lately, and I heard monsters have increased in number on the path to Liyue... I may have to put my money in the Kalimi Exchange if this goes on."

731951404.text: "You don't sound like someone who does legit business... But if it's the Flame-Mane, I heard that she's been hired by the Homayani family. You're gonna have to wait quite a while before she's available again."

731951405.text: "And a word of advice, your money will be better spent buying 100 carpets than investing in the Kalimi Exchange!"

731951406.text: "You're absolutely right! Please visit our shop to buy some carpets! I can even explain in detail about how you can use each of them!"

731951501.text: If you encounter anyone with a blank gaze or muttering to themselves in the forest, they are researchers in Satyavada Life. Please do not disturb them.

731951502.text: If they cause any concern, please report it to the Mahamata for proper handling of the matter.

731951601.text: "I heard that Diwan used to be an organization that spoke out for us downtown commoners, but now it just obeys whatever the Mahamata say."

731951602.text: "Vizier too. That man never keeps his word. He's only there when the Mahamata tries to shed responsibility."

731951603.text: The Akademiya's guidance to all administrative bodies is based on the guidance of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. Please refrain from slander.

731951701.text: "The city of wisdom is ours, as is the forest of ignorance. Atop the tree lies the remnants of the kingdom of lost dreams."

731951801.text: "I heard that Diwan used to be an organization that spoke out for us downtown commoners, but now it just obeys whatever the Mahamata say."

731951802.text: "Vizier too. That man never keeps his word. He's only there when the Mahamata tries to shed responsibility."

731951803.text: The Akademiya's role is to provide guidance to all administrative bodies. Please refrain from slander.
